args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an ~18% error rate. Release history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy, and v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all production regions.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
